pins.definition: A sweet crystalline substance used to make food and drinks taste sweet.
A sweet, white, crystalline powder made from beets or cane, used to sweeten food and drinks.
A sweet white or brown substance added to food and drinks to make them sweet.

situation: A baker at a wooden counter scoops a snowy mound of white crystals into a paper bag.
subject: the sweet white powder
brief: A woman in a striped apron stands at a bakery counter, her hand buried wrist-deep in an open canvas sack of brilliant, dazzling white crystalline powder. A miniature avalanche of the granules spills over the rim onto the dark wood, catching the bright overhead light like fresh snow.
